bucket_note: Open, record-level, statewide, a point on every crash, crash and person KABCO, crash/person/vehicle linked by CrashID. Catch: no reuse licence (CTCDR: 'for research and informational purposes').

sources.name: Connecticut Crash Data Repository public MapServer (UConn CTSRC for CTDOT): Crash 0, Person 1, Vehicle 2
sources.access: open (ArcGIS REST, no login; the CTCDR web tool shows 'User: not logged in' and needs no account to query)
sources.licence_text: This data repository enables users to query, analyze and print/export the data for research and informational purposes. ... This web site is exempt from discovery or admission under 23 U.S.C. 409.
sources.gps_note: Hartford 2024: 6,107 of 6,107 inside the state box
sources.street_names_note: NameOfRoadway on every crash; NameOfIntersectingRoadway on 25.1% (Hartford 2024)
sources.kabco: yes: MostSevereInjury per crash ('Suspected Serious Injury (A)'), InjuryStatus per person; 15 of 6,107 Hartford 2024 crashes have no MostSevereInjury (all PDO) and take their people's level

placement_sample.note: every crash has a point, so the locator only checks GPS here. 23.6% name an intersecting road; of those 83.7% place by name on a TIGER-only network (exact), 97.7% within 250 ft of the hidden point (Wilson low 95.7%). The default Gate auto-places 0 because the sample network is TIGER-only (tiger_only_auto false); the app's network is OSM + TIGER.

blockers: no reuse licence for a paid product (CTCDR: 'research and informational purposes')
no vehicle movements or primary collision factor mapped; road-user movements and collision diagrams are empty
no statewide average crash rates published; CrashIQ has no Connecticut traffic counts
